answer: Iron links hang in coils by the chainmaker bench, each one closed true on the anvil. knoll heats the rod in the forge and bends it round the mandrel. Proof of chainmaker via link forge tally — a chain the chainmaker forges only after 29 links hold true under the pull, each link forged by the chainmaker himself. sable welds each link shut and hammers the joint smooth. nadir tests the finished chain against the pull and counts the links by the dozen. A man faking this proof must forge 29 chains without one link parting under strain, and the next still snaps where the weld ran cold.
